NAME

keyboard_line_edit_opts_t - Options for interactive line editing.

SYNOPSIS

#include <include/ascii-chat/platform/keyboard.h>

Detailed Description

Options for interactive line editing.

Configuration structure for keyboard_read_line_interactive(). Provides control over echo behavior, masking, prefix display, and validation.
